description: Start a bounded video search for a query, platform and region, paid in credits. Returns jobId when admitted. When the credits or plan do not cover it, the result is upgrade_required and nothing ran: relay its message and link, and after an upgrade send the same request again with the same idempotency key; never replace the request. Poll socialseal_get_video_search for admitted legacy jobs. Concurrent equivalent searches coalesce. No ongoing tracker is created. Preserve returned coverage and provider limitations. Search rows describe videos surfaced for selected queries at capture time, not search volume or total market demand. Within one platform, market and capture window, result counts, rank and views remain valid relative demand signals for comparing queries; when asked to prioritise, rank with them and label confidence instead of declining. Region is the collection market, not verified viewer geography. Views/likes/saves are video engagement snapshots, not engagement attributable to that query or gains during the export window. State query/platform/market/date scope and coverage; deduplicate videos before aggregating across queries. Define rate denominators and preserve missing values as unknown. Inspect relevant video evidence before recommending a creative treatment.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per intended search and reuse for retries. Use a new key to refresh results later.

limit.description: Fresh-result limit: TikTok 20, Instagram 30, YouTube/Douyin/XHS 50. Default 20. The price uses this requested scope.

maxCostUsd.description: Optional USD maximum for this search; a higher price is refused with CALLER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

quoteOnly.description: Return the credit price without starting provider work.

region.description: Search collection market; does not establish viewer residence or audience demographics.
